title: Multi-Turn Jailbreak Gap Quantifier: Measuring Single-Turn vs. Multi-Turn Safety Degradation

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: 41.7% of attacks succeed only in multi-turn format, yet most benchmarks are single-turn. Quantifying this gap directly reveals how much safety evaluation misses. Compelling chain: measurement gap to false sense of security to deployment risk.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Wrapping single-turn prompts in multi-turn templates is primarily prompt engineering. Running both conditions against the same models via API is straightforward. Crescendo-style templates are well-documented. Beginners can implement this.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Clear deliverable: multi-turn gap metric. 50-100 prompts in 2 conditions (single vs multi-turn) is a manageable experiment. Template design is the creative work; evaluation is mechanical. Fits 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
